scope.summary: Author the bodykit_skeleton_defs (BSK-), bodykit_skin_materials (BSM-), and bodykit_export_profiles (BXP-) migrations per Section 13.16 (BK-16.3), completing the BodyKit authority table set: versioned skeleton definitions for 13.18 (TAI-BK-058 versioning law), skin material rows for 13.22, and per-target export profile rows for 13.26, all TEXT-PK prefixed uuid_v7 with event_ledger_event_id and guard_authority_write discipline.
acceptance_criteria: Migration creates bodykit_skeleton_defs (skeleton_def_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY 'BSK-{uuid_v7}', skeleton_json JSONB NOT NULL, version TEXT NOT NULL, event_ledger_event_id TEXT NOT NULL) with the versioning rule (rename/restructure = major bump, additive chains = minor) recorded in the table comment.

Migration creates bodykit_skin_materials (skin_material_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY 'BSM-{uuid_v7}', material_json JSONB NOT NULL, event_ledger_event_id TEXT NOT NULL) and bodykit_export_profiles (export_profile_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY 'BXP-{uuid_v7}', target TEXT NOT NULL, profile_json JSONB NOT NULL, event_ledger_event_id TEXT NOT NULL).
All three tables enforce PK prefix CHECK constraints ('BSK-'/'BSM-'/'BXP-') and NOT NULL event_ledger_event_id.
storage.rs exposes typed insert/fetch functions for each table, each calling guard_authority_write(AuthorityMode::Postgres) first; fetch-by-id returns typed structs, not raw JSON.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without versioned skeleton rows the 13.18 stability contract (AREQ-014) has nowhere to live, and export profiles improvised at export time reproduce Daz's one-generic-FBX failure instead of the per-target profile contract.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit projects and base assets

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
